name: House of Secrets
author: marchmiskin
description: Created for the October 2020 Unity Create with Code Game Jam... except that I had to work during most of the period of the game jam and only ended up having about eight hours to work on the game.  Dagnabbit.  So... yeah; you can consider this just a very rough proof of concept; the controls work, and it's functional, but there's... not much to it.  I'll continue working on it, though, and I'll post updates to my blog, kamawale.net
